coordinates.actor_root: Scene ground-contact reference; do not fit each pose to its visible bounding box.
coordinates.registered_pixel_transform: actor_root + scale * (rotate(local_pixel, registration.rotation_degrees or 0) + registration.translation_px - calibration.anchor_px)
coordinates.display_natural_height_px: Injected by scene; the counting-garden guide is 650px, not a per-frame measurement.
coordinates.mirror_rule: No automatic whole-character mirroring; maintain hat and hand identity. Board gaze changes eyes/head only.
coordinates.missing_pivot_rule: A head/shoulder pivot has not been measured. Do not present a guessed point as registered source geometry.

bear-beret-wave-sheet-v001.registration_source: Frame regions and support points are measured in registration_path. Natural-height calibration and actual playback remain unverified; do not derive a scale from the grid.

registration_source_resolution.note: Copied JSON retains its original res:// names unchanged for provenance. Resolve these names to local sources below; do not require the external Godot checkout at playback time.
registration_source_resolution.legacy_source_neutral_note: idle-registration-v1.json also references original base-v3 art for its historical 985px measurement; that file is not a playback input for these clips.

reactions.note: Natural-height proxy excludes the beret. Use each frame's registered translation; baked-in airborne lift is not a second root jump.

seated.note: 985 * 276 / 686 is the inherited proxy. It is distinct from the current canonical PNG's 997.5249772933697px registration. Seated total bounding-box height is not natural standing height.
